modes.turnsHint: You give the turn to the next deck. The hand of each player stays hidden until you show it.

local.facts: {{life}} life points, {{hand}} cards in hand, {{library}} cards in library

status.unknownPlayer: The game has no player with this ID.

shared.title: Shared screen
shared.hint: Open the table window on a second screen, or share it on Discord or in a stream. The table window masks the hands and the libraries. Keep this window open: when you close it, the other windows stop.

online.title: Online game

create.title: New online game
create.hint: You play this deck. Send the invite link to the other players. They join with an account or as a guest.

join.title: Join the game
join.accountHint: Select the deck that you play.
join.guestHint: You join as a guest. Enter a nickname and the deck that you play.
join.deckLinkHint: Paste the link of one of your decks or of a public deck.
join.deckLinkGuestHint: Paste the link of a public deck.
join.deckTextHint: One card on each line, for example "1 Sol Ring". 250 lines at most.
join.deckLinkInvalid: The deck link is not correct. Paste the link of a deck page.
join.deckTextEmpty: The deck list is empty. Paste a deck list.
join.noInvite: This link has no invitation. Ask the host for the invite link.
join.nicknameHint: With no name, the game uses the public name of your account.
join.lineErrors: The server cannot read these lines of the deck list. Correct them, then join again.

lobby.loading: The page connects to the game.

table.noSeat: Your seat is not in the game.

status.reconnecting: The connection stopped. The page connects again.
